summary: All eleven occurrences are stem I hide/skin removal. No distinct lexical sense, Detransitive or idiom is established.
The Preterit L-agent forms distinguish ǧləṭle, ǧləṭli and assimilated ǧləṭṭe. ǧəlṭina is Infectum; ǧlaṭu is Imperativ. German liess at PrS 63/8 is contextual causation, not evidence of another stem.
The unchanged plain Preterit at PrS 84/39 presents an already-completed event retrospectively without -wa. The clearer full contexts were preferred.
ǧlṭ is kept distinct from the reader-mentioned glṭ paper/paint use; no root is merged solely on approximate spelling.

Round 2 only. Jan English is project machine translation, retained verbatim in selected excerpts; semantic decisions rest on the Turoyo. Round-1 proposals are retained as the baseline and are not repeated in this JSON.
ǧəlṭiwole is plural habitual Infectum-wa with a singular animal patient. The preceding uncurling and following eating locate skin removal within food preparation, not another stem or Detransitive.
Round 1 already clarified the gloss to enthäuten and documented whole-animal patients, Infectum and Imperativ. Only the new -wa cell and Jan support are proposed here.
The printed ǧ is retained. No approximate-spelling merger with glṭ/ġlṭ or unsupported claim about how hedgehog skin was removed is made.
PrS 57/15 duplicates the inherited cow-hide/drum sentence cited as prs 153/2 with additional references. Establish the edition-number concordance before altering references or adding it again.
PrS 63/8: is the minister the direct actor or an instigator? Stem I remains the attested form; the edition's causative wording does not settle agency.
Confirm whether household animal-skinning ǧlṭ and surface-peeling glṭ are felt as related or separate lexemes; the current filing follows the supplied entry.
The removable hide and the animal being skinned alternate as direct patients; human skin from the neck also occurs. These are patient choices in the same removal event.
Hedgehog as whole-animal patient supports the round-1 skin/animal alternation. The spiny animal does not create a new meaning of skin removal.
